title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1114 | 流星雨之夜、熊猫新家、狗狗冲浪
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🌠 周二晚上抬头看天！狮子座流星雨要来啦，每小时能看到十到十五颗流星！
🐼 两只大熊猫平平和福爽坐飞机从成都飞到美国亚特兰大，住进了全新的熊猫馆！
🏄 狗狗们在加州踩着真正的冲浪板参加冲浪比赛，十一岁的 Sugar 赢得了大狗狗组冠军！

📖 Word of the day: meteor（流星）

🎮 小挑战：周二晚上和家人一起抬头看天空、数流星，再把今天的单词 meteor 教给一个人！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🌠 On Tuesday night, look up! The Leonid meteor shower is coming, with ten to fifteen shooting stars every hour!
🐼 Two giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, flew all the way from Chengdu to their brand new home at Zoo Atlanta!
🏄 Dogs rode real surfboards in a surfing contest in California, and eleven-year-old Sugar won the big dog contest!

📖 Word of the day: meteor

🎮 Tiny challenge: on Tuesday night, look up at the sky with your family and count the shooting stars, and teach someone today's word, meteor!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. meteor（流星）
a bright streak of light in the sky, made by a tiny bit of space dust
例：I saw a meteor last night!（我昨晚看到了一颗流星！）

2. twinkle（闪烁）
to shine with little quick flashes of light
例：The stars twinkle in the sky!（星星在天空中闪烁！）

3. munch（大口嚼）
to chew something noisily
例：The pandas munch bamboo all day!（熊猫们整天大口嚼竹子！）

4. surfboard（冲浪板）
a long board you stand on to ride waves
例：Sugar stood on her surfboard!（Sugar 站在她的冲浪板上！）
